definitions.explanation: A strong feeling of dislike or repulsion toward something or someone. Stronger than simple dislike.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}に{嫌悪感|けんおかん}を{抱|いだ}いた。
examples.english: I felt disgust at his attitude.

examples.japanese: {暴力|ぼうりょく}を{嫌悪|けんお}する。
{自己|じこ}{嫌悪|けんお}に{陥|おちい}ることがある。

notes:
{嫌悪|けんお} is a formal/literary word for strong dislike or revulsion.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嫌悪感|けんおかん}: feeling of disgust
- {嫌悪|けんお}する: to loathe, to abhor
- {自己|じこ}{嫌悪|けんお}: self-loathing
- {嫌悪|けんお}を{抱|いだ}く: to harbor disgust

CONTRAST:
- {嫌|きら}い: dislike (more casual)
- {憎|にく}しみ: hatred (more personal/emotional)
- {軽蔑|けいべつ}: contempt, disdain
